datasheet_identity.title: MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: MM3Z4V7 zener voltage is specified as minimum 4.4 V, nominal 4.7 V, maximum 5.0 V at IZT = 5 mA; the breakdown-voltage field records nominal and this note preserves the full range.

The MM3Z4V7 table specifies ZZT = 80 ohm at IZT = 5 mA and ZZK = 800 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA; these impedance fields are preserved here because the strict extraction schema has no zener-impedance properties.
The capacitance figure is a family typical curve, not a tabulated MM3Z4V7 point, so specs.capacitance remains null while the digitized family curve is retained.
Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and Tj = -55 to +150 degC at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.
